drafts.walkScript: Line 14 returns a leaver's cardigan, but line 33 puts his jumper in "the Friday box". On line 47 he says "It won't fit me next year." On line 48 Miss Bhatt looks "longer than the answer needed", so size is not everything. He is letting go of next year, and line 38's "September football trials" fall in it. So the space left on that sheet is one he is not going to fill.
